decisions.reason: Although Product A is only modestly promoted, it has remained on the website for two years, so a large established German machinery firm is likely to keep supporting it and explain weak traction as temporary rather than admit failure quickly.
Product B has had its own product page since launch, indicating visible investment and public commitment that, under escalation of commitment, makes withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
Product C is also prominently maintained on its own page across both years, suggesting dedicated development effort and a commitment the firm would be inclined to defend rather than reverse soon.
Product D was put on the home page in 2024, a strong public signal that it is strategically important, so management would be especially reluctant to pull it after such a visible launch.
Product E was explicitly launched as a new laser cabin with its own page, and that specific public rollout raises the pressure to justify the investment and keep it on the market.
Despite lower website prominence, Product F is backed by an industry award, giving management a credible basis to treat any commercial disappointment as temporary and continue with the product.
